policy.pass_condition_observed: Upgrade from Jonoka fork checkout reinstalls Jonoka files; git pull against Jonoka origin does not strip patches.
policy.risk: If SCRIPT_DIR is an upstream-only clone (sdyckjq-lab), git pull + install_bundle overwrites installed skill with upstream and Jonoka patches are lost.
policy.recommendation: Always run --upgrade from this fork (Jonoka/llm-wiki-skill), or after any upstream merge reinstall from the fork. Do not point upgrade SCRIPT_DIR at pure upstream without re-applying fork commits.

files_changed_after_upgrade_notes.PRODUCT.md: Refreshed from fork working tree (release checkbox / current PRODUCT). Still Jonoka content; not upstream overwrite.

pass_criteria: Critical Jonoka files present with markers; CODEX_HOME resolve works; no missing audit/runtime/lint patches; changes only expected reinstall from fork source.
